principle: Language, location/jurisdiction, Christian tradition, calendar system and timezone are independent dimensions. None may be inferred from another.

dimensions.locale: UI language and localised editorial presentation
dimensions.tradition: Roman Catholic, Greek Orthodox, Eastern Orthodox, Anglican and other supported Christian traditions
dimensions.jurisdiction: country, bishops conference, patriarchate, local church or other competent ecclesial authority
dimensions.calendarSystem: Gregorian, Julian, Revised Julian or other source-declared system
dimensions.timezone: IANA civil timezone used to resolve Today, tomorrow and date-sensitive reminders

publicExposureRule: A locale becomes public only when UI, calendar coverage, localised names, source provenance and product-critical copy pass readiness checks.

sourcePriorityExamples.authority: Dicastery for the Causes of Saints

productBehaviour.today: Resolve local date by user timezone, then filter/label by chosen tradition and jurisdiction.
productBehaviour.calendar: Never silently merge conflicting observances; expose differences by tradition/jurisdiction.
productBehaviour.saintPage: One historical identity can have multiple observances, names, ranks and devotional contexts across traditions and jurisdictions.
productBehaviour.readings: Use the lectionary of the selected jurisdiction; do not substitute another country's wording or numbering.
productBehaviour.prayer: Prayer metadata is localised and tradition-scoped; full text is shown only when rights allow.
productBehaviour.saved: Saved identity is language-neutral; display name is re-resolved in the current locale whenever possible.
productBehaviour.chronology: Historical identity timeline is shared; ecclesial events and observances retain tradition/jurisdiction context.
productBehaviour.marianTitles: Mary is one person identity; Marian titles are separate title/observance entities localised by tradition and geography.

globalRollout.goal: Polish, Russian, Filipino and Swahili growth
